avis.texte: The Ordinary Matrixyl + Hyaluronic Acid Serum is a standout anti-aging formula at an unbeatable price. After just a few weeks, my skin looks noticeably firmer, smoother, and more hydrated. The Matrixyl 3000 and Matrixyl Synthe’6 peptides really do help soften fine lines, especially around my eyes and mouth. The hyaluronic acid is not super thick and gives lasting moisture without feeling sticky or heavy, and I love that it’s fragrance-free and gentle on my sensitive skin. It layers beautifully under moisturizer or makeup and works for all skin types. Used morning and night, it delivers visible results that rival high-end serums. A must-have in any skincare routine!

avis.titre: Impressive results for mature skin—worth every drop!
avis.texte: I’m 51 and have tried more serums than I can count, but The Ordinary Matrixyl 10% + Hyaluronic Acid has truly impressed me. I’ve been using it twice a day for about two months, and the difference in my skin is undeniable—especially around my mouth, forehead, and under-eye area. The fine lines have softened noticeably, and my skin feels plumper and hydrated all day. It absorbs quickly without feeling sticky, and it layers beautifully under moisturizer and makeup. I love that it’s fragrance-free and gentle even on my sometimes sensitive skin. The price point is unbeatable for the quality—especially compared to other high-end anti-aging serums I’ve tried that didn’t deliver half these results. If you’re in your 40s, 50s, or beyond and looking for something effective, affordable, and easy to fit into your routine, I highly recommend giving this one a try. My skin looks smoother, firmer, and simply healthier. I’m officially hooked!

The Ordinary’s Matrixyl 10% + HA is a lightweight peptide serum that helps improve the look of fine lines and overall skin texture with consistent use. It won’t deliver dramatic results overnight, but after a few weeks the skin feels smoother and slightly firmer. It absorbs well, doesn’t sting, and works for most skin types. Its biggest strength is the great quality for the price, though if you’re looking for very fast or intense results, it may fall a bit short.

Amazing product for hydration. It's a great primer for makeup since it dries a little sticky and leaves your skin glowy. Also great for layering in your skincare routine; I use it before moisturizer and tret. No fragrance, light formula, and doesn't irritate my skin at all. Highly recommend for you to try out.

I’ve been incorporating more peptide products into my skincare routine, and this serum has been a great addition. The formula feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and layers well with the rest of my products without feeling sticky or heavy. After several weeks of consistent use, my skin feels smoother, more hydrated, and overall looks healthier. I especially appreciate that it’s gentle enough for daily use and doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. The dropper makes application easy, and a little product goes a long way. For the price, it’s an excellent value compared to many higher-end peptide serums on the market. If you’re looking to add a peptide serum to your routine for extra hydration and support for smoother-looking skin, this is definitely worth trying.

avis.titre: Instant glow after first use! ✨️Instant glow after first use! ✨️
avis.texte: I used this for the first time this morning, and my skin is already glowing. It feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and layers beautifully without any stickiness or irritation. I’ve been using it in tandem with my Illiyoon moisturizer, and the combination has been amazing so far. My skin looks smoother, more hydrated, and just overall healthier after one use, which honestly surprised me in the best way. It also doesn't really have a fragrance, which is nice. I’ll be updating this review with before and after photos over the next few weeks to track longer term results, but first impressions are very positive. So far, I’m loving it. ✨😌👀♥️

I have used this product for over 2 months,and I love it! Its a must in my morning routine. My forehead wrinkles were deep and skin was dehydrated. After just a few days, I started noticing the difference. And while I still have my wrinkles, they are less visible. Even noticed the difference around my eyes! Will continue to use this product!
The entire ordinary line is a staple for me. After about 2-3 weeks of daily use, I noticed my pores were smaller. It only got better from there. It’s not over priced and actually does what it says.

avis.titre: **⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Noticeable Skin Plumping and Smoother Texture**
avis.texte: The Ordinary Matrixyl 10% + Hyaluronic Acid has been a great addition to my skincare routine. The serum has a lightweight, silky feel and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky residue, making it easy to layer with moisturizer and other products. After consistent use, my skin feels more hydrated and looks a bit plumper, especially around fine lines where dryness used to be more noticeable. Over time, my overall skin texture appears smoother and more refreshed. It’s gentle, effective, and easy to fit into a daily routine. The 30 ml bottle lasts a long time since only a small amount is needed each application. If you're looking for an affordable anti-aging serum that focuses on hydration and improving skin texture, this is a strong choice. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

avis.titre: Must have for those with sensitivities
avis.texte: I love this product line. I have ridiculous sensitive skin and it took a long time for me to find a product that didn't irritate my skin. Their products feel so nice and hydrating. None of them are oily. Some are a little tacky when layering but I think that means you have to wait a little longer between layers. I feel the quality is great and I have seen results in a 60 day time span. I have deep forehead wrinkles that I am self conscious about and these products have done such a great job plumping my skin back out. All of the ingredients are safe for people like me with sensitivities. I was unsure how and when to layer so chatgpt whipped up a routine for me that I follow religiously. will be sticking with this line!
I have been using for about a month. Skin does look softer, maybe a few less wrinkles. I will continue to use this product.

This serum has been a great discovery for my skincare routine. The texture is light, it absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin feeling very hydrated without any stickiness. After using it for several days, I've noticed my skin is softer and fine lines are slightly less visible.

I bought multiple products from The Ordinary, and all of them arrived in good condition. I really like the Matrixyl. The only downside is that I’m not a fan of sticky skincare products, and this one is a bit sticky, but it works well for the reason I bought it.

avis.titre: Would I let this serum babysit my life? Yes
avis.texte: Why did you pick this product vs others?: Matrixyl is for when you want to look like you’ve got your life together—even if your skin is the only part of you that does. Moisturizing: It’s got peptides. It’s got hydration. It’s got that barely-there dewy bounce that makes people say “you look well-rested” while you’re Googling “chronic insomnia, can you die from it.” (You can.) Moisture level: This serum makes your skin feel like it has a LinkedIn profile. It’s serious, but friendly. It shows up. It tightens up. And it does all this for, like, the price of a sad sandwich. Quality: Can’t beat it. Mix it with Argireline and suddenly you’re aging in reverse like it’s a tax-deductible flex.

I have seen a lot on social media about using the ordinary matrixyl with the ordinary argireline solution to soften fine lines and wrinkles, and to help with skin tightening and clarity. I should have done more research before purchasing this. This product is a complete waste of money. I used it for 30 days and it does not do anything that the company claims. The product does go on and absorb into my skin easily enough, but leaves my skin feeling oily and greasy. I spoke with my Dermatologist who verified that this product or the combination of these two products from the ordinary are a complete waste of money and the only result I might see are clogged pores and more congestion! My advice is to not believe everything you see on social media and to definitely do your research before wasting your money on these products!

I started using The Ordinary Matrixyl 10% plus Hyaluronic Acid serum on February 14 and developed significant facial irritation within a few days. My skin felt tight, burning, and overly sensitive, similar to a sunburn. The irritation spread across my cheeks and did not improve even after simplifying my routine. I understand skincare is individual, but in my case this product disrupted my skin barrier and caused noticeable discomfort. I would recommend patch testing and introducing it very slowly, especially if you have sensitive or reactive skin. Clear, factual, and measured.
